disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of ten elements in waterleaf and lettuce from three wastewater-irrigated farms in Kaduna, printed per farm.

study.design: Farm sampling of two leafy vegetables from three wastewater-irrigated farms
study.origin: three farms (Rafin Romi, Juji, Station) on the outskirts of Sabon Tasha, Kaduna metropolis, Nigeria; irrigated with water from the Kaduna River and drainages
study.method: AAS (PG-990) after HNO3/HClO4/H2SO4 digestion of air-dried then oven-dried (105 °C) leaves
study.qa: none reported (no CRM, recovery or blanks described)
